Hi, Candice King here — founder of Zaytun.

Two years ago, I began helping a single displaced Palestinian family. One became two. Two became ten. Ten became a thousand.

Among them were mothers, fathers, and children — not only displaced by violence, but also silently battling cancer without a home, consistent care, or safety.

My promise — to you, and to them — is to make helping Palestinians with cancer my life's mission.

Thank you for being part of this journey, and for being someone who saves lives.
Buying this set brings healing.

How it works


You buy the Shada Cancer Bows

Our designer necklace come in 14ct gold or sterling silver. They are timeless and embody our movement.

Your Questions
Thoughtfully answered

What are the Shada Cancer Bows made from?

Our Shada Cancer Bows is made from 925 sterling silver or 14ct gold plating which is optional for those wanting a warm gold finish.

How long is shipping?

Our jewelry is ship internationally and will arrive on your doorstep within 10-25 days. All of our pieces are hand-packed and sent in our beautifully designed custom packaging.

How much is shipping?

There is no shipping fee. All of our jewlery is shipped internationally at no additional cost at all.

How do you donate to cancer treatment?

With every necklace, pair of earrings and set purchase, we donate 100% of the profits to Palestinians in need of chemotherapy treatment in Cairo. We do this through local partners and doctors who have a database of the most urgent cases. These organisations are vetted to ensure they provide high quality treatment to people that actually need it.

Can I return it?

Yes, we offer free and easy returns for 25 days. If you are unhappy with your piece for any reason, just contact us and we'll replace it for you, hassle-free.
